AC–66
AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – TROUBLESHOOTING

A C Control Assembly Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

This circuit includes the control switch circuit and the LED circuit in the A/C control Assembly.
The A/C amplifier always searches which switch is operated and drives the LED according to A/C control operation or diagnostic sensor check operation.
